thread: Project-built cotton line, 2.1 mm in diameter, with gravity sag and a finite-length free end. Reconstructed from the ready-fine rigid replay.
pearl: 5.4 mm ivory bead with a through-bore, threaded 30 mm from the cut end.
guides: Rounded eyes with exterior bonded seats on sourced pipe stock.
shelves: Additional placements of the installed NVIDIA SimReady notebooks, cups, and dishes.
grip: The lower bill lifts the bare thread into a measured two-sided grip. The jaw opens at the recorded ladle release. Grip motion is fitted to the replay and does not re-solve jaw friction.
